---
title: "Nested tuning without information leakage"
output: rmarkdown::html_vignette
---

Candidate parameters must be compared on fixed inner partitions. When an outer
design is requested, `ps_tune_interpolation()` sees each outer holdout only
after selecting parameters inside that outer training set. Every failed
candidate remains in the manifest. Without outer validation, scores are tuning
performance and should not be presented as unbiased final performance.

```{r, eval=FALSE}
tuned <- ps_tune_interpolation(
  points, "IDW", list(idw_power=c(1, 1.5, 2), idw_nmax=c(8, 15)),
  inner_design="spatial_block", outer_design="kfold", seed=31
)
```
